corrections.why: No page read states a visiting rule for this site. The register names only the administrator, and Willhite says its author had not visited the site.

notes_for_editor: Only the register, firelookout.com and Willhite were read; Willhite quotes the Kresek inventory, which I did not find. The likely location is Willhite's guess, not a confirmed site. The record's 'permission' access level has no source read. A second search on Quinault permission returned only neighboring-site pages (Point Grenville, Elk Creek, Salmon River), which are not used here. The Quinault Indian Nation would be the place to ask about access and the location.
